law: Binding an artifact into inference_run is a job: every phase reports progress, and a cancel landing in any phase is answered CANCELLED within the ceiling. A cancelled binding leaves no half-open guest behind, so the next binding of the same artifact answers the same document an uncancelled one does. The compiling-component phase is reached only by a cold compile; its cancellation is the compile law's (🏠️workspace/🧫️fixtures/⏱️compile-cancellation-law.json). The loading-document phase is reached only by a session bound to a hub document; its cancellation is the stepped load's (📡️spr/🧵️channel/🧫️fixtures/🧫️document-archive-load-host/🔣️.json and 🏠️workspace's long-history load law).
